# AI4Kanban

> AI4Kanban is an open-source, local-first kanban board for AI agents. It prepares the
> key drafts for each task — a UI mockup, a copy draft, a storyboard, figures — so you
> settle the direction first, then specialist agents finish the rest within the agreed
> scope. It covers product development and content creation, and connects to 8 tools
> such as Claude Code and Codex, running on your machine with your own subscriptions.

Each page below has a plain-Markdown mirror (the `.md` links) with the full page
content — no navigation, styling, or scripts.

## Pages

- [Home — See the draft. Let agents do the rest.](https://ai4kanban.dev/index.md): AI4Kanban prepares key drafts for tasks on your board. You review what matters, agents handle the details, and you move more work forward on your own.
- [Builder — why Tao Wu is building AI4Kanban](https://ai4kanban.dev/builder.md): How Tao Wu went from trying to let agents plan a project on their own, through early users' feedback that it didn't feel faster, to having people confirm key drafts before agents build the rest.
- [Kanban for Claude Code](https://ai4kanban.dev/agents/kanban-for-claude-code): How AI4Kanban turns rough ideas into Claude-ready tasks, shares project memory across tasks, coordinates dependencies and isolated worktrees, and reuses an existing local Claude Code setup.
- [Kanban for Codex](https://ai4kanban.dev/agents/kanban-for-codex): How AI4Kanban turns rough ideas into Codex-ready tasks, preserves decisions across sessions, coordinates dependencies and isolated worktrees, distinguishes reasons for human attention, and reuses an existing local Codex setup.
- [AI4Kanban for coding](https://ai4kanban.dev/workflows/coding.md): Review key details on the task card before coding to reduce rework: UI, prompt, copy and email drafts with phone and desktop previews, questions that shape the feature, preference memory per agent, follow-up suggestions after delivery, and what the workflow cost against direct Claude Code in a small October 2026 test.
- [AI4Kanban for SaaS](https://ai4kanban.dev/solutions/saas.md): For SaaS founders and small teams moving product development and marketing forward on one board: review key drafts before building, illustration, copy, competitor research on the competitors you name, product newsletter drafts, carousel posts and product videos (Pro), preference memory per agent, follow-up suggestions, and your own coding tools and subscriptions.
- [draft-first — see the draft, then build](https://ai4kanban.dev/draft-first): An open-source skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and other coding agents that read `.claude/skills/` or `.agents/skills/`. Install with `npx draft-first install`. Before building, the agent drafts screens, prompts with sample outputs, copy and images; you delete, note and confirm them on a local review page, and the agent builds from what you confirmed. Drafts stay in `.draft-first/` in your project. Source: https://github.com/ai4kanban/draft-first
- [Download — AI4Kanban for macOS, Windows and Linux](https://ai4kanban.dev/download): Get the desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux — nothing to install first. Every file on the current release (Apple Silicon and Intel `.dmg`, the Windows `.exe`, the x64 and arm64 `.AppImage`), and what to click past each system's first-open warning while the builds are unsigned.
- [AI4Kanban vs. Taskmaster](https://ai4kanban.dev/vs-task-master.md): Both break work into tasks with dependencies. AI4Kanban adds built-in specialist agents and workflows, review of key drafts before implementation, and preference memory that carries into later tasks; Taskmaster offers MCP integration, a dedicated research command and a built-in test-first coding workflow. Covers task chat, follow-up suggestions, execution, CLI and MCP, and licensing.
- [AI4Kanban vs. Hermes Agent Kanban](https://ai4kanban.dev/vs-hermes-kanban.md): Both break work into dependent tasks and run them in parallel git worktrees. AI4Kanban adds built-in specialist agents and workflows, review of key drafts before implementation, and settled requirements before agents build; Hermes Kanban offers control from chat apps, automatic recovery of stalled tasks, and a REST and WebSocket API. Covers questions, follow-up work, merging, recurring work, Claude Code and Codex, and review.
- [AI4Kanban vs. Multica](https://ai4kanban.dev/vs-multica.md): AI4Kanban comes with specialist agents and workflows, ready out of the box: hand off your first piece of work in 10 minutes. Agents run in parallel, drafts keep the quality of every delivery in your hands, and they keep learning as they go.
- [AI4Kanban vs. Orca](https://ai4kanban.dev/vs-orca.md): Orca adds a thin layer around coding agents, with capabilities that overlap with the Codex desktop app. AI4Kanban provides a ready-made team to lead execution details while you set the direction and make key decisions.
- [AI4Kanban vs. Plannotator](https://ai4kanban.dev/vs-plannotator.md): Compare Plannotator's plan, document and PR review with AI4Kanban's built-in specialist agents, key drafts, parallel tasks, memory and follow-up suggestions.

## Documentation

Every documentation page carries a "Copy page" button that hands you its raw
Markdown, so these need no separate mirror.

- [Documentation overview](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs): How to run AI4Kanban, the kanban board for AI agents: install it, drive the daily loop, and pick the coding agent your work runs on.
- [Your first card](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/first-card): Follow an idea through planning, review the screen draft, request changes, then build and check the delivered work.
- [Draft review](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/drafts): See the final version of the parts you care about most, change it on the card, and approve what agents will build.
- [Memory](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/memory): How project memory, agent memory and global memory carry your preferences forward, and how they stay current without you.
- [The daily loop](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/daily-loop): The rhythm once the board exists: pick what to work on, add and refine cards, build one end to end, check what it leaves you, and finish it.
- [Multi-runtime support](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/connectors): Connect the coding tool you already use, choose a runtime and model for each agent, and set what a run may touch.

## More

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ai4kanban/ai4kanban): Source, user guides, and an example of AI4Kanban managing its own development.
